steps.note: Open the prepared closed RFQ with two bids in Master QCS.
Enable eRFX projects as required by the case.
Apply the required proposal note-to-director configuration.
Enter the award allocation flow needed to create the proposal.
Allocate the line item to the case's proposed vendor.
Confirm the proposal allocation is for one of the two available vendors.
Create and open the award proposal page.
Verify that the award proposal page opened.
Click only the Participants control and record whether it opens or changes anything, without confirming any proposal action.
Verify that the Participants exploration leaves the browser on the award proposal page.
Confirm the Participants control remains visible after the click.
